The Petitioners have filed this petition against Respondents for the relief of compensation under Sec.166 of Motors Vehicles Act, 1989.

2. The petition averments are briefly stated as under:

2 That on 31.03.2023 at about 6.00 p.m. Ramesh C.R. had been riding his motor cycle bearing Reg. No.KA- SCCH 5 40-EE-1952 to his village Chigatagere, when he reached near Pothenahalli Village, SH-9 Road, Thondebavi Hobli, Gowribidanur Taluk, Chikkaballapura, at that time, a car bearing Reg. No.AP-39-RB-0097 came at high speed in rash and negligent manner and dashed against his motor cycle, due to the said impact Ramesh C.R.
sustained injuries and died on spot.

sentences.text: Immediately after the accident, body was shifted to Gowribidanur Government Hospital, wherein postmortem was conducted and petitioners have spent more than Rs.1,00,000/- towards transportation and death ceremony of the deceased.
3. At the time of accident, deceased/Ramesh C.R. was aged about 27 years, working as BBMP Garbage Auto Driver, thereby drawing salary of Rs.25,000/-.
Petitioner No.1 is mother, petitioner No.2 to 4 are sisters of the deceased Ramesh C.R.
Due to untimely death of the deceased, petitioners are suffering from lot of SCCH 5 financial assistance.

Out of the said accident, crime No.55/2023 is registered against the driver of the said car bearing Reg. No.AP-39-RB-0097 before the Manchenahalli PS for the offences punishable under Sec.279, 304(A) of IPC.
Respondent No.1 is insurer and respondent No.2 is owner of the offending car, they are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation.

Hence prays to allow the petition and grant compensation of Rs.75,00,000/-
with interest.
4. On service of notice, respondent No.1/insurer has appeared and filed written statement and denied the entire case of the petitioners.

Further submitted that, it is the insurer of the car bearing Reg. No.AP-39-RB-0097 and liability to indemnify the owner subject to terms and conditions of the policy and also seeks protection available under Sec.147 and Sec.150(2) of M.V.Act.

Further submitted that, driver of the car bearing Reg.
SCCH 5 No.AP-39-RB-0097 was not holding a valid and effective driving licence as on the date of accident and also denied relationship and petitioners with deceased.

Further respondent denied age,
occupation and income of the deceased.
Accordingly prays to dismiss the petition.
Respondent No.2 being R.C. Owner has remained absent, hence placed exparte.

5. On going through the rival pleadings of the parties this court framed following issues:
::ISSUES::
1. Whether Petitioners prove that, deceased Ramesh, S/o. Late.
Rangappa died in the motor vehicle accident that occurred on 31.03.2023 at about 6.00 p.m. near Pothenahalli Village, SH-9 Road, Thondebavi Hobli, Gowribidanur Taluk, Chikkaballapura due to rash and negligent driving of Car bearing Reg. No.AP-39-RB-0097 dashed against the deceased and caused accident, as mentioned in claim petition?

3 SCCH 5 2.

6. In order to prove their case, Petitioner No.1/mother of the deceased examined as PW-1 and exhibited 14 documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.14.

On the other hand, respondents have not adduced any evidence.
7. Heard the arguments and perused the evidence available on record and my findings on the above issues are as follows:
 Issue No.1 : In the Affirmative  Issue No.2 : Partly in the Affirmative  Issue No.3 : As per final order for the  following:
 ::REASONS::
8. Issue No.1:- In order to prove their case, petitioner No.1/mother of the deceased has examined as SCCH 5 PW-1.
In the chief-examination affidavit she has reiterated the facts narrated in their petition.

In order to prove the rash and negligent driving of driver car bearing Reg.No.AP-39-RB-0097 P.W-1 got marked copy of FIR as per Ex.P.1, copy of complaint marked as per Ex.P.2, copy of spot mahazar marked as per Ex.P.3, copy of sketch is marked as per Ex.P.4, copy of IMV Report is marked as per Ex.P.5, copy of charge sheet is marked as per Ex.P.6, copy of P.M.Report is marked as per Ex.P.7, copy of Inquest Report is marked as per Ex.P.8, copy of Sec.133 notice is marked as per Ex.P.9 and copy of reply to notice under Sec.133 is marked as per Ex.P.10.
9. On perusal of evidence of PW-1 and the records those were marked as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.10 corroborates the case of the petitioners about causing of the accident dated 31.03.2023 as alleged in the petition.
SCCH 5 10.

Per contra, except appearance and filing of written statement, respondent No.1 has not taken any endeavors to disprove the petitioner's case about the manner of the accident as alleged in the petition and evidence of PW-1.

Since in the absence of iota of evidence, it can be believed that death of Ramesh C.R. was due to road traffic accident occurred on 31.03.2023 at about 6.00 p.m. when he was riding a motor cycle bearing Reg. No.KA-40-EE-1952 near Pothenahalli Village, SH-9,
Thondebavi Hobli, Gowribidanur Taluk, Chikkaballapura.

In this regard argument addressed by counsel for the petitioner that accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving on the part driver of car is proved by evidence lead by petitioner before court.

Under SCCH 5 such circumstances,
considering the said evidence of petitioners this tribunal comes to the conclusion that, petitioners have proved the above issue No.1.
Accordingly Issue No.1 is answered in the affirmative.
12. Issue No.2:-
As per the case of the petitioners, deceased/Ramesh C.R. was aged about 27 years as on the date of accident.
For proof of age of the deceased, copy of aadhar card of the deceased is marked as per Ex.P.14,
wherein the of date of birth of the deceased is mentioned as 02.07.1996, the alleged accident was occurred in the year 31.03.2023.
In Ex.P.7 the age of deceased is mentioned as 26 years.

Accordingly relying on Ex.14 the age of the deceased is considered about 27 years as on the date of accident, hence multiplier 17 is applicable with reference to decision reported in 2009 ACJ 1298 in between Sarla Varma and Others V/s. Delhi Transport Corporation and others.

sentences.text: SCCH 5 13.
As per the case of the petitioners, deceased was working as BBMP Garbage auto Driver under Sri Lakshmiranganatha Swamy Enterprise, thereby drawing monthly salary of Rs.25,000/-.

In order to prove the said facts, petitioners have furnished copy of salary certificate issued by Sri Lakshmi Ranganatha Swamy Enterprises marked as Ex.P.11, copy of ID Card marked as Ex.P.12 and bank pass book marked as Ex.P.13.
To substantiate the Ex.P.11 and 12 the petitioners not examined the Proprietor of Sri Lakshmi Ranganatha Swamy Enterprises.

More than that as per Ex.P.11 the monthly salary of Ramesh C.R for a tune of Rs.23,000/- per month was credited to his account through NEFT but quiet contrary to this it is evident from Ex.P.13 Savings bank pass book that it was opened on 22/12/2022 nearly 3 months prior to accident.
Further in Ex.P.13 there is only one entry of Rs.54,000/- through NEFT on SCCH 5 13/01/2023 which will not tally with the salary as mentioned in Ex.P.11.
In Ex.P.13 there is a mention of deposit of Rs.23,000/- on 21/03/2023 the same will not corroborates with the contents of Ex.P.11 as the salary was credited from 21/03/2023.

Under such circumstances, with reference to the year of accident, relying upon the guidelines issued by Hon'ble Karnataka State Legal Services Authority Bengaluru, notional income of the petitioner is taken at the rate of Rs.15,250/- p.m. so that, said fact is taken into consideration for the purpose of calculation of loss of dependency.

entities.text: Karnataka State Legal Services Authority Bengaluru
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 14. Further petitioner No.1 is mother, petitioner No.2 to 4 are sisters of the deceased/Ramesh C.R.

To prove the said facts, they have furnished notarized copy of aadhar card of petitioner No.1 to 4 marked as Ex.P.14 it reveals that, they are legal representatives of the SCCH 5 deceased/Ramesh C.R., hence they will become dependents of the deceased.

15. As per the case of Sarla Varma, if the deceased was bachelor, then 1/3 of the income is to be deducted towards personal and living expenses of the deceased, so that, 1/3 of the income will be deducted at the time of calculation of compensation amount.

16. In the Special Leave Petition (CIVIL) No.25590 of 2014 in between National Insurance Co. Ltd.,
V/s. Pranay Sethi, the Hon'ble Apex Court has made it clear that, an addition of 40% to be added to the monthly income, if the deceased was aged below 40 years, in case of fixed salary employee.

Further they are entitled for loss of estate of Rs.15,000/-

19.

Accordingly I hold that, the Petitioners are entitled for total compensation of Rs.29,73,532/-
with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.

21. In the case on hand, respondent No.1 being the insurer of the car bearing Reg.
No.AP-39-RB-0097 has issued insurance policy bearing No.1-2JJA9FAHP400 # SCCH 5 M006808 Lakshminarasamma vs Iffco Tokio Gen Ins Co. Ltd on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189580520/

For all these reasons Issue No.2 is answered partly in the affirmative.
22. Issue No.3:

In view of the above reasoning and discussions to the above Issues No.1 and 2, I proceed to pass the following:
::ORDER::
The claim petition filed by the Petitioners under Sec.166 of the M.V. Act, 1989 is partly allowed with cost.

The Petitioners are entitled for compensation of Rs.29,73,532/- (Rupees Twenty Nine Lakhs Seventy Three Thousand Five Hundred Thirty SCCH 5 Two Only) with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
The Respondent No.1 shall deposit award amount with interest within 60 days from the date of this order.

The Petitioners are entitled for compensation at the ratio 70:10:10:10 in the award amount.
The petitioner No.1 to 4 are entitled to get release 60% of the award amount through e-payment directly to their accounts on furnishing the Bank A/c details and remaining 40% shall be kept in Fixed Deposit in any of the Scheduled Bank for a period of three years, in their respective names.
The Advocate Fee is fixed at Rs.1,000/-.
Draw award accordingly.
